mechanism_claims.claim_text: AMP2 reduced S. epidermidis biofilm area and FISH-positive bacterial area on polyurethane in source-reviewed FISH imaging assays.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: AMP2 (KRRWRIWLV) against S. epidermidis PIA 8400 biofilm
mechanism_claims.limitations: This supports biofilm disruption/reduction, not a molecular membrane-lysis mechanism.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: AMP2 inhibited S. aureus biofilm metabolic heat output in microcalorimetry and high-dose treatment was associated with near-complete biofilm killing.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: AMP2 against S. aureus ATCC 29213 biofilm on glass beads
mechanism_claims.limitations: Biofilm effect requires higher AMP2 concentrations than planktonic MIC/MBC; do not generalize to all biofilms or in vivo cure.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: AMP2 decreased intracellular S. aureus burden in primary osteoblast-like cells after treatment, supporting a cell-associated antibacterial effect.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: AMP2 against internalized S. aureus in primary human osteoblast-like cells
mechanism_claims.limitations: Exact CFU values are figure-derived; final artifact keeps the qualitative/significant reduction claim rather than overextracting image-only counts.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: The paper discusses cationic AMP membrane interaction as background rationale, but it does not directly prove a molecular membrane-disruption mechanism for these five peptides.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Do not promote background membrane-interaction discussion to direct mechanism evidence for AMP1-AMP5.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: AMP2 can be incorporated into PDLLA coating and produce zones of inhibition against S. aureus in local-delivery assays.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: AMP2 in poly(D,L-lactide) coating against S. aureus
mechanism_claims.limitations: This is an in vitro local-delivery assay and does not establish clinical efficacy.

quality_controls.note: No background membrane statement is classified as direct_mechanism.

adjudication_note: Worker-6 replaced automated mechanism placeholders with source-reviewed phenotype/mechanism-boundary claims and avoided promoting literature background to direct molecular mechanism.
